description: Djibouti Public Transport Routes is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transport", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). The following surveys were carried out: • GIS mapping of bus routes, carried out by survey staff travelling bus routes with GPS enabled phones, using GPS Essantials The objective of these surveys was to develop a picture of the urban transport sector, including, on the supply side, the financing and provision of vehicles and ... Coverage: Djibouti. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Transport. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
